author: locman1
body:
To server's Devs, Mods, and Helpers.

I am deeply sorry for me fly hacking last year and I will do anything to make it up to you guys even pay for unban,
because avicus is my most favourite server to play games on and me fly hacking was a mistake me a and my friend were doing something on LAN server with our hacked clients that day and I forgot I had my client still on and accidentally clicked the F button which activate my fly hacks,
I will never do it again.

Sincerely, locman1
